english.title: Act/omission due to which trader engaged in unfair commercial practice by omitting material information
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), due to your act or omission, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT OR OMISSION..), a trader, namely **(..SPECIFY TRADER..),

(A)_[committed an offence of engaging in an unfair commercial practice by omitting material information from an invitation to purchase under section 237(6) of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024]_
(B)_[would have committed an offence of engaging in an unfair commercial practice by omitting material information from an invitation to purchase under section 237(6) of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 but for a defence under section 238 of the Act]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 237(6), 239 and 240 of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
trader having committed an offence under section 237(6) of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 OR
would have committed an offence under that subsection but for a defence under section 238
commission of the offence/of what would have been the offence was due to your act/omission

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For the offence under section 237(6) of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024 see H101736.
(ii) A person commits the offence whether or not he or she is a trader and whether or not his or her omission is a commercial practice, see section 239(2).
(iii) A person may be charged with and convicted of this offence whether or not proceedings are taken against the trader, see section 239(3).
(iv) Section 238 of the Act provides a defence of due diligence and innocent publication.
(v) See section 239(5)-(7) for corporate liability.
